Hi Aline — great, thanks. Quick answers and the next steps listed below.

Mandatory invoice fields from our AP system:
- Vendor legal name (must match bank account owner)
- Vendor tax/VAT id (where applicable)
- Invoice date and sequential invoice number
- Redwood PO number (please place PO number on invoice header and each invoice line)
- Line-level description and unit/qty where applicable (we map to PO line codes)
- Remittance instructions: Bank name, IBAN, SWIFT/BIC, account holder, and billing currency

On split billing and multiple invoices:
- We can accept multiple invoices against a single PO (e.g., monthly invoices against a retainer). Each invoice must reference the PO number and include the invoice-specific sequential number.
- For split payments across two ClearEdge legal entities: ideally you either (a) issue separate invoices from the vendor entity that matches the bank account to be paid, with PO line allocation noted, or (b) provide a consolidated invoice with a clear allocation table indicating amounts payable to each legal entity on the PO. If you choose (b), AP will still require the VAT IDs for each ClearEdge entity to validate tax treatment.

VAT / reverse-charge:
- For EU reverse-charge we require a copy of your VAT certificate (or EU VAT ID). We do not operate a self-billing program for third-party vendors in this engagement by default — ClearEdge must invoice us with the VAT handling shown. If there are special self-billing requirements, we can discuss but it will need legal approval.

Attached is our AP onboarding packet (starter checklist + field mapping). Please: 1) complete the vendor registration in our portal (link below), 2) upload the signed PO and VAT cert, and 3) send the first invoice PDF referencing PO 9342.

Portal (preferred): https://vendorportal.redwood.ai/register?ref=clearedge-9342
AP inbox (for manual files): procure@clearedge.fr

I'll loop Laura (finance) for any tax specifics — she can confirm net terms and internal routing.

Best,

Adding a couple of technical notes from an integration perspective so ClearEdge's file/portal upload maps cleanly into our AP: 

- Our PO line code is a 10-char alpha-numeric (e.g., PO9342-LN01). Please ensure line codes are included in the invoice PDF as free-text; our OCR occasionally needs the exact pattern.
- CSV/EDI feed (optional): if you want to automate invoice submission, we accept a 12-column CSV (invoice_no, invoice_date, po_number, po_line, description, qty, unit_price, currency, vat_rate, vendor_vat_id, remittance_account, remittance_reference). I can share the template if useful.
- Max character lengths: invoice_description 240 chars; vendor_name 80 chars. Long service descriptions should be attached as a separate statement of work PDF and referenced from the invoice.
- File naming: <vendorname>_Invoice_<invoice_no>_<date>.pdf helps our ingest.

Laid out above so we avoid rework during ingestion. Marissa — is Net45 the standard for this account?

Thanks,
Karthik

Antoine — received, and thanks for the quick turnaround. Confirmations and next steps: 

1) Allocation table: yes — if each invoice includes a clear allocation table that lists amounts payable to each ClearEdge legal entity (with VAT IDs), our AP system can route payments to multiple bank accounts as long as we have corresponding vendor banking records for each entity in our vendor portal. Please ensure the allocation row includes: entity name, VAT ID, bank IBAN, SWIFT, and the alloc_amount.

2) Payment timing: Net45 is the default for this engagement. Once we receive a fully compliant invoice (PDF attached to the portal and metadata filled in) the payment will be scheduled in the next available run — typically payment executes on invoice_date + 45 calendar days, subject to bank cutoffs. If you need accelerated payment we can discuss a short-term ACH / early-pay program; that's an exception and requires procurement approval.

3) Portal and upload: Use the vendor portal link (preferred) to create the vendor record and upload Signed_PO_9342.pdf and ClearEdge_VAT_Certificate.pdf. If you encounter issues, send files to our secure AP mailbox: ap-files@redwood.ai (cc procure@clearedge.fr).

4) Contacts: For VAT/tax questions please include Laura Bennett (laura_bennett@redwood.ai). For integration automation, Karthik will share the CSV template if you want to programmatically submit invoices.

I'll update HubSpot with the PO and attachments. Once the vendor record is active you should see a confirmation email from the portal.

Best,
